articles.title: First-Ever Glimpse of a Black Hole Devouring a White Dwarf Star
articles.summary: The Einstein Probe telescope detected an extraordinary X-ray flash from a distant galaxy. Scientists believe it's the first direct evidence of an intermediate-mass black hole tearing apart a white dwarf. The event was one of the brightest outbursts ever recorded.

articles.title: Ship Speed Limits Saved Right Whales — Now NOAA Questions Their Future
articles.summary: Mandatory speed restrictions for large vessels have reduced fatal whale strikes since 2008. NOAA is now investigating whether detection technology could replace the rule. With only about 380 North Atlantic right whales remaining, conservationists say losing the speed limit would be disastrous.

articles.title: Earth May Have Been Seeding Venus with Life for Billions of Years
articles.summary: A new study suggests that asteroid impacts on Earth could have blasted microbe-carrying rocks to Venus. Researchers estimate billions of cells may have reached Venus's clouds, where conditions might allow survival. The findings revive the panspermia hypothesis for our nearest neighbor.
